item.title: Pastry 1.0
item.description:
Pastry 1.0

Pastry is a fast, private clipboard history for your Mac. Press Shift-Command-V, find what you copied, and press Return to paste it.

  • Free to start. Pastry shows your five newest items for free. Buy it once for $29.99, with no subscription, to unlock your full history, collections, the paste stack and iCloud sync.
  • Private by default. Everything stays on your Mac unless you turn on iCloud sync, which is end-to-end encrypted. Tracking is stripped from links, and location data from photos.
  • Keeps itself up to date. Pastry checks for updates once a day. You can also choose Check for Updates from the menu bar.
  • Pastry for iPhone is free. It shows your Mac's history through iCloud and adds things from the share sheet.
